response.overview: When one first begins their spiritual journey, it feels like a divide emerges between themselves and their own mind. They become aware of the incessant chattering in their own head; a mental voice that always seems to have another problem to deal with, another worry, another fear, desire, like, dislike, etc. They want to shut it up. Life is heaven when the mental voice is quiet, hell when it is loud. They try everything they can: negotiating with it, listening to it, fighting it, suppressing it… but the mental voice is simply too strong. It doesn’t oblige, it makes clever arguments, and it has many deceitful tricks. It can act like different people who have different values just so it can continue constantly talking.
